sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Lodin is an obtainable Unit in the game. A lone and mysterious knight from Lizeria who sought out to find and defeat the Ten-Winged Tormentor, Melchio. Befitting his lone nature, he sought out to find and battle the toughest enemies he could face. Despite all of his, he keeps on losing to Melchio. He joined Michele and the gang in hopes of defeating it. He is the foil to Michele's brash and spoiled attitude, despite the latter calls him a loser.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Lodin's age when he was first introduced was 25 years old.
